name: How long does a typical exterior door installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical exterior door installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an exterior door installation can vary depending on the door type, the complexity of the opening, and whether any structural modifications are required. A standard replacement often takes one to two days. However, projects involving custom sizing, significant frame adjustments, or integrating new door styles as part of a larger whole-home remodel may extend the timeline. As part of our managed process, AKN Design Group provides upfront estimates and transparent scheduling, ensuring clear communication throughout your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard exterior door installation typically takes one to two days, but custom or complex projects may require more time due to structural considerations.
